corrected_text: Agello's DeviceProfile (a691212) stops a running reply when os_proc_available_memory() is above 0 and below 400,000,000 bytes (checked on each memory warning and at each ~100 ms streaming flush), and keeps the chat's conversation across a helper only when available memory is at least 28,672 x the positions the chat holds in the KV cache (ChatEngine.usedTokens: the conversation's token count, or the seeded count before the first send) + 400,000,000 bytes, or available is 0: 869,762,048 bytes with 16,384 positions held. Until Agello e084e1f (2026-11-14) the rule counted maxNumTokens instead, and until 6db56c6 (2026-11-11, as at 93122b647a) it kept the chat only on a runtime with a build id.
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17, Agello read at a691212 (what the app does moved). DeviceProfile.swift:43 lowMemoryStopBytes 400_000_000; :45-47 shouldStopForMemory availableBytes > 0 && < 400 MB, called from AppState+Reply.swift:175-178 at each >= 100 ms flush and from relieveMemoryPressure on every memory warning (AppState.swift:189-208, MemoryPolicy.action always includes stopReplyIfExhausted). :65-69 keepsConversationAcrossHelpers(usedTokens:availableBytes:): available 0 -> keep; else available >= 28,672 x usedTokens + 400,000,000. ChatEngine.swift:129-134 usedTokens = getTokenCount() if > 0 else seedTokens; :561-573 beginHelper calls it. 28,672 x 16,384 = 469,762,048 + 400,000,000 = 869,762,048. History: git show 6db56c6 removes the runtimeKeepsSessions guard (Google's-binary code gone); e084e1f replaces maxNumTokens by usedTokens. The 93122b647a source is kept for the history clause. The claim's '(ours, not Google's v0.18.0)' no longer describes the app.

corrected_text: LiteRT-LM's SetCommonGpuOptions calls SetUseMetalArgumentBuffers(true) under __APPLE__, and every GPU executor calls it: the vision, audio and embedding executors directly, and the main LLM executor through CreateCompilationOptions (llm_executor_settings_utils.cc, GPU case). LiteRT's Metal delegate turns the option off only when argumentBuffersSupport == MTLArgumentBuffersTier1; with Apple's tables putting tier 2 argument buffers at Apple6 and later, our build binds kernel arguments through argument buffers for every GPU graph, the Gemma decoder included, on every Apple6 or newer GPU, including every iPhone Agello supports. The release Agello ships (6da75396) makes the same calls: these executor files are identical there.
note: Re-pin 2026-11-17: at b7b856a0 litert_compiled_model_executor_utils.cc:1013-1045 SetCommonGpuOptions, :1036-1038 SetUseMetalArgumentBuffers(true) under __APPLE__; callers (git grep): vision_litert_compiled_model_executor.cc:96, audio_litert_compiled_model_executor.cc:87, embedding_litert_compiled_model_executor.cc:208, llm_executor_settings_utils.cc:163 (CreateCompilationOptions, GPU case; the old source's lines 84-103 were a different block, re-cited to 160-164). delegate_metal.mm:349-357 drops the option only on MTLArgumentBuffersTier1. git diff 6da75396 b7b856a0 is empty for litert_compiled_model_executor_utils.cc, llm_executor_settings_utils.cc, the vision, audio and embedding executors and agello/litert's delegate_metal.mm, so the release makes the same calls; the claim's last sentence described the v0.18.0 source of Google's binary, which Agello no longer ships.
